title: Strong, eventual and weak consistency

kcs.statement: Under strong consistency every read returns the most recent acknowledged write, which typically requires reading from the leader or waiting for replicas to agree.
Under eventual consistency replicas may return stale values for a while but converge to the same value once new writes stop.
Under weak consistency a read may never see a given write, which is acceptable for data such as live video frames or game positions where only the latest value matters.

problem_ideas: Assign a consistency model to: bank balance, follower count, VoIP audio, seat inventory, profile bio, DNS record
A tweet's like count differs across two phones for 3 seconds: name the model and say if it is acceptable
